comments.body_html:
Excellent mod, only problem it triggers when looting a corpse My grenade button is leftAlt Left alt + click is to grab and equip a weapon from a corpse It launches a grenade when I do it in the menu I have setted up a delay of holding of 0.7 to workaround this but maybe you can disable the function in menus

comments.author: DeePix
comments.body_html:
Thanks for the report and for the kind words!

That’s a very good catch. I hadn’t considered the interaction between DPX-QuickThrow and common looting shortcuts such as Left Alt + Click.

Tomorrow I’ll look into adding a new option in the F12 configuration menu that disables DPX-QuickThrow while looting, searching containers, or interacting with corpse inventories. That should prevent accidental grenade throws in menus while keeping the feature available during normal gameplay.

In the meantime, your 0.7s hold delay workaround is probably the best solution.

Thanks again for the feedback, and for helping improve the mod!

comments.body_html:
So with 1.0 I have the problem, that I can only quickthrow nades I brought with me into the raid.

With 1.1 I have the problem that the nade is pulled first and then quickthrown, which makes for a super janky feel ;)

comments.author: DeePix
comments.body_html:
Thanks for the feedback.

v1.1 intentionally changed the throw sequence to fix an issue where grenades could reuse an old target location and throw in the wrong direction.

The downside is exactly what you’re describing: the grenade is now equipped and armed before the throw happens, which can feel less smooth than v1.0.

I’m currently testing a new approach that should keep the correct throw behavior while making the animation flow feel closer to the original quick throw.

comments.author: DeePix
comments.body_html: Thanks, that’s actually a great idea. I’ll add it to the roadmap as an optional feature, probably with a config toggle so people can enable it only if they want it.

comments.author: DeePix
comments.body_html:
Thanks for the feedback, and thanks for taking the time to test the mod.

I’ve added this issue to my bug tracker. Right now I’m collecting all reported problems and working through them one by one.

So far I’ve identified a few edge cases involving grenade switching, inventory interactions, and some situations where the throw state doesn’t seem to refresh correctly. I’m currently investigating those and trying to make the behavior fully consistent.

I really appreciate the reports, they help a lot because they often reveal situations I wouldn’t normally encounter during my own testing.

Thanks again for helping improve the mod!
